decisions.reason: Visibility rose from a mention to a dedicated page, a sign of growing commitment, and keeping a core safety shoe line costs little for an in-house manufacturer.
Its uncertainty is still unresolved and the cost of keeping a simple insole accessory is low, but it is only mentioned and overlaps with the flagship FIT insole, so the option is weaker.
The insole is cheap to keep and complements the foot-measurement offering, though its static, low visibility and overlap with other insoles leave a modest risk of consolidation.
Its dedicated page in both years shows sustained commitment to the ergonomic series, and that series fits the firm's direction of tailored, innovative workplace footwear.
It moved up to a dedicated page and opens a specialised firefighter segment, a valuable option that should be kept open while its value develops.
This flagship moulded insole has been on the home page in both years and has a concrete reference customer (ALBA Braunschweig), so its value is being realized and further commitment is justified.
